Terms of Service & Data Privacy
Project ANDAM Disaster Monitoring System

1. Compliance with Republic Act No. 10173

Project ANDAM (Automated Network for Disaster Advisory and Monitoring) complies with the Philippine Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173). By using this platform, you acknowledge that your personal information, including your name, email address, mobile number, and real-time GPS location, is collected exclusively for flood monitoring, automated alert dissemination, and safe navigational routing.

2. Purpose of Processing

  • Drivers/Public: Live GPS processing to detect proximity to flood hazards and calculate safe bypass routes.
  • Administrators: Verification of official identity (Name, Phone, Address, Valid ID) to safeguard sensor controls and emergency alerts.
  • SMS Recipients: Direct early-warning notifications during critical water level surges.

3. Data Subject Rights

In accordance with Section 16 of RA 10173, you retain the right to be informed, access your stored data, dispute inaccuracies, and request account de-registration or erasure by contacting the designated system administrator.

4. Disaster Advisory Disclaimer (RA 10121)

Sensor telemetry, water levels, passability statuses, and AI-suggested routes are automated advisories. Users must exercise independent judgment and defer to instructions from local DRRM officers and authorities.
